evidence.claim: Guillemot progetta e produce dal 1984 hardware e accessori per il gioco su PC e console, distribuiti in più di 150 paesi nel mondo.
evidence.quote: A designer and manufacturer of interactive entertainment hardware and accessories, listed on the stock market since 1998 and active in this field since 1984 || The Group is currently present in eleven countries (France, Germany, Great Britain, Spain, the Netherlands, the United States, Canada, Italy, Belgium, Romania and China - Shanghaï, Shenzhen and Hong-Kong ), and distributes its products in more than 150 countries worldwide. || Gaming accessories for PC and consoles, for experienced and casual gamers.
